title: The Honest Answer: Base Case Yes, Full Reflection No
content: A **club** below an ordinal $o$ is a set that is unbounded below $o$ and contains all its accumulation points below $o$; a **stationary** set meets every club. The open question asks whether this substrate extends to **reflection** and to Jensen's $\square_\kappa$. The answer is partial, and this file proves exactly the ZFC-true part. **Clubs reflect** unconditionally: cutting a club at one of its accumulation points yields a club below that point (`clubReflects`). But three neighbouring statements are deliberately **not** proved because they are false or independent: (i) 'the trace of a club is itself a club' is **false** when $\mathrm{cf}(o) = \omega$ — e.g. $\mathrm{Trace}(\mathrm{Iio}\,\omega,\ \omega) = \varnothing$ because no finite ordinal is a limit point — so it needs $\mathrm{cf}(o) > \omega$; (ii) full **stationary reflection is independent of ZFC** (forced false by $\square$), so it must never be recorded as verified; (iii) $\square_\kappa$ needs an order-type / coherence module beyond the current `Set Ordinal` idiom. The whole file is axiom-free and reuses `Proofs.Club.Basic` unchanged.
mathContext: Base case (ZFC theorem): a club below $o$ cut at an accumulation point $\alpha \le o$ is a club below $\alpha$. Stationary reflection: independence-sensitive, not shipped.
prerequisites: club and stationary sets below an ordinal
why full stationary reflection is independent of ZFC

title: Reflects and Trace
content: Two definitions set up the reflection layer. `Reflects C α := IsClubBelow (C ∩ Iio α) α` says **C reflects at α**: the initial segment of C below α is a club below α, so the club structure of C is 'seen' locally at α. `Trace C o := {α | α < o ∧ α.IsAcc C}` is the set of **reflection points** — the ordinals below o at which C accumulates. Two unfolding lemmas accompany them: `mem_Trace` (membership iff α < o ∧ α.IsAcc C) and `Trace_subset_Iio` (the trace lies below o). These are the vocabulary in which the base case and its corollaries are phrased.
relatedConcepts: accumulation point of a set of ordinals
prerequisites: Set.Iio and set intersection on ordinals

title: clubReflects — the base case of stationary reflection
content: The load-bearing theorem: if C is a club below o and α ≤ o is an accumulation point of C, then C ∩ Iio α is a club below α. The three club fields are discharged locally. **subset**: C ∩ Iio α ⊆ Iio α is inter_subset_right. **closed**: via isClosedBelow_iff, an accumulation point p < α of C ∩ Iio α is also an accumulation point of C (IsAcc.mono, since C ∩ Iio α ⊆ C); it lies below o because p < α ≤ o, so closedness of C (hC.closed.forall_lt) puts it in C, and p < α puts it in Iio α. **unbounded**: IsUnboundedBelow (C ∩ Iio α) α is precisely the hypothesis α.IsAcc C read through IsAcc.forall_lt — for each p < α it yields δ ∈ C with p < δ < α, i.e. δ ∈ C ∩ Iio α with p < δ < α. Crucially, no cofinality assumption is used: this is the unconditional ZFC-true core, in contrast to stationary reflection.
mathContext: $\mathrm{IsClubBelow}\,C\,o \wedge \alpha \le o \wedge \alpha.\mathrm{IsAcc}\,C \Rightarrow \mathrm{IsClubBelow}(C \cap \mathrm{Iio}\,\alpha)\,\alpha$. Closedness is local; unboundedness IS the accumulation hypothesis.
prerequisites: closedness of a club below an ordinal

title: Trace containment, reflection points, monotonicity
content: Three corollaries of the base case and closedness. `trace_subset : Trace C o ⊆ C` — a club contains its whole trace, because every accumulation point below o already lies in C (IsClubBelow.mem_of_isAcc); reflection here happens at members of C, not at external ordinals. `reflects_of_mem_trace : α ∈ Trace C o → Reflects C α` — C reflects at every point of its trace, obtained by feeding clubReflects the bound α < o (weakened to α ≤ o). `Trace_mono : C ⊆ D → Trace C o ⊆ Trace D o` — the trace grows with the set, since accumulation points are monotone (IsAcc.mono).

title: Nonemptiness and axiom-freeness
content: `reflected_nonempty : Reflects C α → 0 < α → (C ∩ Iio α).Nonempty` records that where C reflects, the reflected club is nonempty (a club below a positive ordinal is nonempty, IsClubBelow.nonempty). The file closes with `#print axioms` on clubReflects, trace_subset, and reflects_of_mem_trace, all reporting exactly the three standard foundational axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) — no sorryAx, no native_decide / Lean.ofReduceBool. The reflection base layer is thus fully verified and axiom-free, a clean downstream extension of Proofs.Club.Basic that sibling slugs can build on while the □ frontier remains precisely characterized as future work.
